36 package main                                                                                                         
35                                                                                                                      
34 import (                                                                                                             
33     "fmt"                                                                                                            
32 )                                                                                                                    
31                                                                                                                      
30 type GapBuffer struct {                                                                                              
29     data []rune                                                                                                      
28     gap  int                                                                                                         
27     size int                                                                                                         
26 }                                                                                                                    
25                                                                                                                      
24 func NewGapBuffer(initialSize int) *GapBuffer {                                                                      
23     gb := &GapBuffer{                                                                                                
22         data: make([]rune, initialSize),                                                                             
21         gap:  initialSize,                                                                                           
20         size: 0,                                                                                                     
19     }                                                                                                                
18     return gb                                                                                                        
17 }                                                                                                                    
16                                                                                                                      
15 func (gb *GapBuffer) MoveGap(position int) {                                                                         
14     if position < 0 || position > gb.size {                                                                          
13         return                                                                                                       
12     }                                                                                                                
11     if position < gb.gap {                                                                                           
10         for i := position; i < gb.gap; i++ {                                                                         
 9             gb.data[i], gb.data[i+gb.gap-position] = gb.data[i+gb.gap-position], gb.data[i]                          
 8         }                                                                                                            
 7     } else {                                                                                                         
 6         for i := gb.gap; i < position; i++ {                                                                         
 5             gb.data[i-gb.gap+position] = gb.data[i]                                                                  
 4         }                                                                                                            
 3     }                                                                                                                
 2     gb.gap = position                                                                                                
 1 }                                                                                                                    
37
